name: reranker_matched_labels
status: EXPLORATORY. Written after an external review raised the issue, before any quantity below was computed. Not part of the original pre-commitments.
reason: On TripClick BM25 the action-utility label is nDCG@10(expanded candidate, cross-encoder reranked) - nDCG@10(original query, BM25, not reranked), so it mixes the effect of expansion with the effect of reranking. The frozen TripClick test already holds a BM25+rerank arm for the original query (results/tripclick-tail_bm25_reranker_only.json, same reranker and top-k composition as the agent's candidate). Re-labelling against it isolates expansion under a common reranker.
data_use: Recombines frozen per-query records only. No generator calls, no retrieval, no reranking, no refitting: the detection model and the action-utility score are the same frozen validation-fit predictions scripts/46 uses.
setting: TripClick TAIL test, BM25, the 1,157 acted-upon queries. NQ BM25 needs no correction (neither arm is reranked). Dense settings have no stored reranked-original arm and are not re-labelled; producing one would be a new test touch.

analyses.M1_label_rates: Matched delta = nDCG@10(candidate) - nDCG@10(BM25+rerank of the original). Report tied/helped/harmed rates, and the fraction of acted queries where harm is possible (reranked-original nDCG@10 > 0).
analyses.M2_action_utility_auc: Frozen action-utility score against the matched label: rule (a) harmed vs rest, (b) helped vs rest, (c) helped vs harmed with ties excluded, and (a) restricted to harm-possible queries. AUC with 95% bootstrap CI.
analyses.M3_paired_gap: Paired bootstrap of detection AUC (unchanged failure label) minus matched rule-(a) AUC on the same 1,157 queries.
analyses.M4_policy_contrast: Mean nDCG@10 difference, paired bootstrap: Static QE (fused, reranked) vs BM25+rerank of the original.

reporting: Every quantity above is reported regardless of outcome and labelled exploratory in the paper.
